title: Count decoded internal whitespace in byte lookup tables
author: sylvesterkaczmarek
novel_contributions: Fixes byte lookup table accounting so internal or repeated SentencePiece whitespace markers are counted as decoded ASCII spaces rather than UTF-8 U+2581 bytes
Preserves the leading-space flag and boundary adjustment while correcting byte-length measurement
Aligns baseline byte denominators with actual SentencePiece detokenization for multiword pieces and repeated whitespace markers
